phase: Phase 7.3.3: Final Gate Correction and Guarantee-Contract Freeze

sub_gate_C1_mathematical_derivation.proof_basis: Triangle inequality on two bounded clock readings: |Delta_tau - T| <= 2 * epsilon = 10ms

sub_gate_C2_infrastructure_enforcement.testbed_kernel_architecture: Shared LinuxKit VM kernel across all Docker containers
sub_gate_C2_infrastructure_enforcement.colocated_drift_status: Zero drift achieved via shared hardware clock, not active NTP disciplining

ideal_g1.scope: Local server time on a single primary node (Regimes 1 & 2)

slew_tolerant_g1_delta.scope: Multi-host physical time under verified Sub-Gate C2 (Regimes 3 & 4)
slew_tolerant_g1_delta.scientific_qualification: G1_delta is a relaxed physical-time envelope, NOT strict preservation of ideal G1

single_event_bound_verification.bounded_quantity: A_event_burst (Event-attributable burst admissions across discrete reset)
single_event_bound_verification.attainability_status: ATTAINABLE_MAXIMUM (Verified via c1=1000, reset, c2=1000 trace)
single_event_bound_verification.accounting_granularity: Per client key ({dreb:state:<clientId>}); NOT aggregate cluster-wide
single_event_bound_verification.single_event_definition: Exactly ONE isolated fault transition: un-replicated failover OR state recreation OR forward clock step
single_event_bound_verification.mutual_exclusivity: Multiple fault mechanisms cannot be combined into a single event
single_event_bound_verification.repeated_events_bound: NO_FINITE_GLOBAL_BOUND (A_event_burst <= (N_E(T) + 1) * C_max -> infinity as N_E(T) -> infinity)

required_assumptions: Sublinear event frequency: lim(T -> infinity) N_E(T)/T = 0
Bounded initial state S(0) <= S_max = 1285.7143 tokens
Restricted distributed failure model (finite failovers over infinite horizon)
g2_asymptotic_scope.g1_boundary_clarification: Asymptotic G2 convergence does NOT protect downstream systems against finite-window G1 burst over-admissions

g3_abuse_recovery_scope.parameter_orthogonality: d=1.5 governs token burn rate; lambda=0.05 governs temporal decay velocity
three_tiers_of_recovery: Tier 3: Physical token refill (requires 0.7s for B, 9.0s for I)

idempotency_contract.wait_1_semantics: Volatile in-memory replica acknowledgement; NOT synchronous disk persistence or Paxos consensus
failover_survival_conditions: WAIT 1 acknowledged on primary connection prior to crash
Replication factor N = 1 (in N >= 2, acknowledging replica promotion is probabilistic)
Idempotency record survives and is visible on newly promoted primary
idempotency_contract.un_replicated_failover_outcome: Duplicate debit occurs upon client retry

redis_cluster_failure_model.promotion_mechanics: Under N=1, sole replica is only candidate; under N>=2, highest-offset election is probabilistic via offset delay formula
redis_cluster_failure_model.jedis_cluster_wait_affinity: JedisCluster is asynchronous; WAIT requires connection pinning
